name: STA237H1 — Deductive Derivation (Law of Large Numbers and Central Limit Theorem)

steps.template_en: X₁,...,Xₙ i.i.d. with mean μ, variance σ². X̄ₙ=(1/n)ΣXᵢ. WLLN: P(|X̄ₙ-μ|>ε)→0. SLLN: P(lim X̄ₙ=μ)=1. Average CONVERGES to expectation. Why polling works!
steps.template_zh: WLLN: P(|X̄ₙ-μ|>ε)→0。SLLN: P(lim X̄ₙ=μ)=1。均值收敛到期望。这就是民调有效的原因！

steps.template_en: WLLN proof (Chebyshev): P(|X̄ₙ-μ|>ε) ≤ σ²/(nε²) → 0. Needs finite variance. SLLN deeper: needs E[|X₁|]<∞, martingale convergence.
steps.template_zh: WLLN证明(Chebyshev): P(|X̄ₙ-μ|>ε)≤σ²/(nε²)→0。需方差有限。SLLN更深。

steps.template_en: CLT: √n(X̄ₙ-μ)/σ → N(0,1) in distribution. Sample mean → NORMAL regardless of underlying distribution (if variance finite). Why normal is UNIVERSAL in statistics.
steps.template_zh: CLT: √n(X̄ₙ-μ)/σ→N(0,1)依分布。样本均值→正态不论底层分布。正态是统计中普适的。

steps.template_en: Die roll (uniform {1..6}, μ=3.5, σ²=2.92). Roll 30 dice, average. Repeat 1000× → histogram is NORMAL, not uniform! CLT in action.
steps.template_zh: 掷骰子(均匀，μ=3.5)。掷30次取平均。重复1000次→直方图正态！CLT在行动。

steps.template_en: LLN: more data → better estimate. CLT: uncertainty ~ normal (large n). Together justify: polling, quality control, Monte Carlo, confidence intervals.
steps.template_zh: LLN: 更多数据→更好估计。CLT: 不确定性近似正态。一起证明：民调、质量控制、蒙特卡洛、置信区间。

steps.template_en: 'Emergence of certainty from randomness' is deepest insight. LLN+CLT explain WHY statistics works: individual unpredictable, AGGREGATES predictable. Monte Carlo method key application.
steps.template_zh: '从随机涌现确定性'是最深刻洞见。LLN+CLT解释为什么统计有效：个体不可预测，聚合可预测。
